description: Search apps in the App Store or Google Play by keyword. Returns ranked list of apps with metadata (results are returned in store ranking order). Works without an API key (free tier, limited daily use per IP). If the store is throttling, the result may be Sonar's stored copy: it then comes back as `{ data, meta }` with `meta.stale: true`, its date in `meta.stale_as_of`, and a `meta.note` to pass on to the user.

country.description: Market as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. "us", "gb", "de", "mt"). Any App Store storefront (175 countries) or Google Play market (145). Default "us".

num.description: Number of results to return (1-50, default 10).

store.description: App store. "ios" for Apple App Store, "android" for Google Play.

name: sonar_app_search
title: Search Apps
